title: Traditional Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the best of Ukrainian cuisine with the comfort of pork dumplings.

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.notes: Ground pork is ideal for this recipe.

ingredients.name: fatty
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter is the fatty ingredient of choice.

ingredients.name: kissed
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh dill adds a kissed touch to the dish.

ingredients.name: ukrainian
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought dumpling wrappers work well.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to bring out the flavors.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of black pepper for extra depth.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Finely chopped onion adds a sweet and savory flavor.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic is essential for this recipe.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.notes: A beaten egg helps bind the filling together.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: Use water to help form the dumpling wrappers.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, butter, dill, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Beat in the egg and mix until the filling is smooth and even.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Carefully place the dumplings into the boiling water and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the dumplings from the water and drain off any excess liquid.
Serve the Ukrainian pork dumplings hot with your favorite toppings, such as sour cream or chopped fresh herbs.
Optional: Pan-fry the dumplings in a little oil until golden brown for an extra crispy texture.
